add.title: Bring Chat v2 (v2/ChatV2.js patch()) to the V1 rule: close the owner's open bubble when another speaker lands below it, instead of re-anchoring it below
add.why: V1 now follows 'nothing on screen moves for a later arrival' (2026-11-01); v2 still pulls its open bubble down past a later reply. One of everything: both views should share the rule.
